title: Implement exact-head review and safe stack restacking

intent.outcome: Close GitHub #2557 by adding an idempotent one-shot exact-head review request and a receipt-backed compare-and-swap restack for explicitly declared PR stacks.
non_goals: Do not restart or depend on the persistent review watcher.
Do not weaken exact-head review authority or automate merge.
Do not rewrite undeclared branches or guess remote heads.

parent.contribution: Complete the exact-head review and safe stack operations lane.
parent.closure_boundary: Close only after stopped-watcher, duplicate, stale-race, successful restack, failed lease, and bounded integration evidence pass.

owned: tools/review_stack_ops.py declared stack planning, publication, metadata, and receipt lifecycle
effects: A PR/head review request is durable and idempotent without a watcher process.
Stale review results point to the current exact-head recheck command.
Restack publication uses explicit old/new base and remote-head identities with force-with-lease.
A receipt distinguishes pre-publication failure from bounded partial remote or metadata writes.

intent_interpretation.literal request: Implement GitHub #2557 as the isolated review-stack lane.
intent_interpretation.inferred intended outcome: Maintainers can re-establish current-head review authority and safely synchronize declared descendants without persistent polling or manual SHA plumbing.
intent_interpretation.chosen concrete what: Add a one-shot reviewer launch bound to PR/full SHA plus a declarative two-or-more-member stack restack command with preflight, CAS publication, optional PR-body updates, and durable receipts.

allowed paths: focused release and lane planning records
stop before touching: Do not change review_merge_gate.py exact-head authorization.
Do not publish any branch unless every local rewrite and patch/ancestry check passes.
Do not update PR bodies until branch publication succeeds, and record every bounded write.

contract_decisions_to_freeze: Review request identity is repository, PR number, and requested full head SHA.
Duplicate running, awaiting, or completed requests reuse one durable receipt.
A stack declaration supplies every branch, PR, old base, new base, and expected remote head explicitly.
Publication uses per-ref force-with-lease; receipts report partial writes rather than claiming atomicity.
validation_commands: uv run ruff check tools/chatgpt_review_loop.py tools/review_stack_ops.py tests/test_chatgpt_review_loop.py tests/test_review_stack_ops.py
bounded dry-run and non-production remote stack dogfood
completion_criteria: A stopped watcher does not prevent one exact PR/head reviewer request.
Duplicate and stale-race requests return durable existing/current-head guidance.
Declared descendants restack without abbreviated or inferred SHA identities.
Success and failed leases produce receipts with rewrite, patch/ancestry, remote, and metadata evidence.

refs: real temporary bare-remote dry-run, publication, lease-failure, and preflight fixtures passed
focused review-stack proof route, maintainer surfaces, Verification report, proof-route cases, contract tooling, structured inventory, and ruff passed

next_action: Create the feature-branch integration proposal and publish the lane PR stacked on #2581.

claims: One-shot review is bound to an explicit PR/full SHA and remains idempotent while the watcher is stopped.
Declared stack restacking is preflighted and published with compare-and-swap leases and receipt-backed metadata writes.
requirements: Run stopped-watcher, duplicate, stale-race, restack success, and lease-failure fixtures.
Dogfood a bounded non-production stack or equivalent isolated remote fixture.

continuation.residual_intent: The operating-decision, system-intent, and memory lanes remain after this PR.
